findings.evidence: Exactly 15 respondents (e.g. R0038, R0044, R0091, R0117, R0191) have a PHQ-9 total of 10.0. The pipeline assigns them 'mild', whereas the correct scoring guide classification is 'moderate'.
findings.description: The scoring pipeline misclassifies a PHQ-9 total score of exactly 10 as 'mild' instead of 'moderate'. According to the PHQ-9 scoring guide, cutpoints are at 5, 10, 15, and 20, where a score sitting exactly on a cutpoint belongs to the higher group (so 10 is 'moderate').
